name: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog
source:
It's Amy Rose's birthday, and she's hosting a murder mystery party on the Mirage Express! When Sonic the Hedgehog becomes the game's victim, everyone is off to get to the bottom of things. However, something feels a bit off - is this really an innocent game or is something more sinister afoot?

Join the colorful cast of the Sonic the Hedgehog series in an exciting new adventure!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324650/The_Murder_of_Sonic_the_Hedgehog/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
今天是艾咪·罗斯的生日，她正在Mirage Express列车上举办一场谋杀推理派对！当刺猬索尼克成了游戏中的受害者，所有人都开始追查真相。然而，总有哪里不太对劲——这真的只是一场无害的游戏，还是有更险恶的阴谋正在酝酿？

与《刺猬索尼克》系列中个性鲜明的角色们一起，踏上激动人心的新冒险！

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2324650/The_Murder_of_Sonic_the_Hedgehog/]Steam[/url]]
